pipeline.summary: Phase 2 data on Spyre Therapeutics’ anti-TL1A antibody SPY072 in rheumatoid arthritis have fallen short of expectations, prompting the biotech to deprioritize monotherapy development in the indication.

pipeline.title: Implantica finally nabs FDA approval 8 years after EU green light for reflux implant
pipeline.summary: The FDA has signed off on Implantica’s gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) implant as the medtech eyes a lucrative U.S. market.

pipeline.title: Spruce’s successful FDA talks plant seeds for Q4 filing of ultra-rare disease drug
pipeline.summary: Spruce Biosciences has taken another step toward filing for FDA approval of its ultra-rare disease drug candidate, ticking off some of the manufacturing tasks needed to submit the long-awaited application.

pipeline.title: [Podcast] (Season 2) The Progress Profile: Alzheimer’s Research in Focus
pipeline.summary: This podcast explores how leading Alzheimer’s experts are working to bridge the gap between clinical trial design and frontline care.

pipeline.title: Roche, Eli Lilly net FDA approval for first-of-its-kind Alzheimer’s biomarker blood test
pipeline.summary: Roche and Eli Lilly have won FDA clearance for their latest Alzheimer’s disease diagnostic.

pipeline.title: Werewolf transforms into Ambros via reverse merger to support phase 3 push for rare disease drug
pipeline.summary: Werewolf Therapeutics’ hunt for strategic alternatives has ended. Ambros Therapeutics has agreed to merge with Werewolf in an all-stock deal and has raised $150 million, positioning the biotech to take its lead rare disease drug candidate through to a filing for approval.

pipeline.title: Boehringer places phase 1 study of investigational drug on hold to examine ‘safety event’
pipeline.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim has suspended a phase 1 trial of an investigational small molecule drug while it seeks to understand a “safety event,” although the German pharma isn't shedding light on the nature of the incident for now.

pipeline.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—China's IIT scrutiny; Daiichi Sankyo, AZ ph. 3 win; Leo, Tanabe's dermatology deal

pipeline.title: Merck-Moderna cancer vaccine win spurs stock jump, speculation of Keytruda-like impact
pipeline.summary: As the dust settles on phase 3 data that added $45 billion to Moderna’s market cap, analysts have begun to ask a question that could define cancer care in the coming years: Can use of the vaccine be as broad as Keytruda?

pipeline.title: Jazz's HER2 bispecific Ziihera gains FDA approval to change practice in stomach cancer
pipeline.summary: Jazz’s bispecific antibody Ziihera has gained FDA approval for first-line HER2-positive stomach cancer, unlocking another market as the company builds toward a $2 billion-plus peak sales target.

pipeline.title: SK Biopharma pens $795M deal to usher Biohaven’s epilepsy therapy towards hoped-for 2029 launch
pipeline.summary: SK Biopharmaceuticals has strengthened its epilepsy offering by paying $350 million upfront to help speed Biohaven’s Kv7 ion channel activator on its way to market.

pipeline.title: New Jazz cancer drug approval could drive blockbuster sales
pipeline.summary: Ziihera can now be used as an initial treatment for all HER2-positive gastroesophageal adenocarcinomas, dramatically expanding the drug’s market potential.

pipeline.title: Teva faces fresh antitrust scrutiny, this time via competition probe in Turkey
pipeline.summary: Teva is increasingly highlighting its innovative drug bona fides these days, seeking to style itself as both a novel drug-producing biopharma and a generics powerhouse.

pipeline.title: Roche, Eli Lilly get FDA nod for new Alzheimer’s blood test
pipeline.summary: Labcorp and Quest Diagnostics both plan to offer the test, which secured CE mark certification earlier this year.

pipeline.title: Labcorp launches new hepatitis D test to find patients with most severe form of virus
pipeline.summary: Labcorp is looking to plug the gap in hepatitis D monitoring with a new reflex testing solution to help find more patients with this form of the virus earlier.

pipeline.title: McKesson strikes $2.25B deal to snap up Precision Medicine Group
pipeline.summary: The healthcare conglomerate, which ranks eighth on the Fortune 500 list, is set to envelop privately held Precision Medicine Group into its oncology branch as part of an ongoing effort to grow its high-margin cancer and biopharma businesses.

pipeline.title: Founded by Metsera backers, Sentivera emerges with $1.5B inflammatory disease deal
pipeline.summary: Having set Metsera on its journey to a $10 billion takeover, Arch Venture Partners and Population Health Partners have powered their new startup—Sentivera—to a licensing deal worth up to $1.5 billion.

pipeline.title: Will a ‘reset’ reignite investment in women’s health startups?
pipeline.summary: After peaking in 2024, venture investments in startups involved in the space declined last year. But a broader adoption of AI and a widening definition of what constitutes women’s health could spur a rebound, some say.

pipeline.title: NAD reaches split decision on hair ad row between Kenvue and Hims & Hers
pipeline.summary: The National Advertising Division has delivered a mixed verdict in a row over hair-loss ads, telling Hims & Hers Health to change certain claims while dismissing other challenges brought by Kenvue.

pipeline.title: Capricor secures reprieve as FDA extends DMD cell therapy review
pipeline.summary: The FDA has extended its review of Capricor Therapeutics’ Duchenne muscular dystrophy drug candidate, deferring the decision to review information the biotech submitted after a negative advisory committee vote.

pipeline.title: Young startups miss out on biotech venture funding rebound, MassBio says
pipeline.summary: A new report found that the sizes of seed rounds and Series A financings for Massachusetts biotech startups are going in opposite directions, as funding slows for young companies with the “riskiest science.”

pipeline.title: Vacant lab space, shrinking workforce put Mass. in ‘unique position’ for biotech bounceback
pipeline.summary: A new report on the health of the Massachusetts biotech scene has painted a mixed picture of how drug developers are faring in the Bay State.

pipeline.title: Lundbeck strikes expanded pact with Eversana to broaden AI scope across US commercial business
pipeline.summary: The partnership builds on previous work and will expand Lundbeck's use of Eversana's AI Agency platform across its U.S. commercial organization, the companies said.

pipeline.title: Lilly covers lifelong obesity journey in new GLP-1 Medicare access campaign
pipeline.summary: The campaign adds older adults to the obesity conversation and is anchored by Lilly's "A Life Covered" short film, which highlights a woman's decades-long weight loss journey.

pipeline.title: Merck, AZ lawsuits against Medicare price negotiations swatted down
pipeline.summary: Courts in Maryland and Washington, D.C., have rejected separate lawsuits by Merck and AstraZeneca against the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services' drug price negotiation program.

pipeline.title: Hansa lays groundwork for Nasdaq debut ahead of US kidney transplant drug verdict
pipeline.summary: With the FDA expected to weigh in on its kidney transplant drug, imlifidase, shortly before year-end, Hansa Biopharma is mulling over its stock listing options in the U.S.

pipeline.title: Safety concerns spur FDA to again halt testing of Regenxbio gene therapy
pipeline.summary: Investigators detected masses on the spines of five patients who received its Hunter syndrome treatment, leading to the program’s second clinical hold this year.

pipeline.title: FDA extends review of Capricor cell therapy; Pain drug startup to go public
pipeline.summary: The agency is now reviewing an updated application for deramiocel with a “refined” indication. Elsewhere, a startup co-founded by Vivek Ramaswamy is taking a speedy path to the public markets.

pipeline.title: Cellares, a cell therapy manufacturing specialist, to lay off 100 employees
pipeline.summary: The restructuring comes after an unnamed "large pharmaceutical customer" terminated a contract with the company, Cellares CEO Fabian Gerlinghaus posted on LinkedIn.

pipeline.title: After Trump order, RFK Jr. seeks input on US pediatric vaccine recommendations
pipeline.summary: HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has joined President Donald Trump in a renewed effort to challenge how the United States formulates its childhood vaccine recommendations. In a Request for Information, Kennedy has asked for public comment over the next 30 days on whether vacci

pipeline.title: Qiagen appoints new chief executive after 9-month search
pipeline.summary: Molecular diagnostics specialist Qiagen has a new CEO as Jonathan M. Pratt takes the reins.

pipeline.title: TME holds onto $1B dream for brain cancer drug as search for partners nears conclusion
pipeline.summary: TME Pharma’s hunt for a partner for its brain cancer drug is closer to bearing fruit as the German biotech clings to its hope of generating $1 billion in peak sales from the asset.

pipeline.title: Cellares CEO seeks to 'resize' company after loss of 'large' cell therapy manufacturing customer
pipeline.summary: With its ascent seemingly unstoppable in the last few years, automated cell therapy manufacturer Cellares is facing some tough new realities.

pipeline.title: Roche commits to lean-mass preservation with Hanmi obesity deal
pipeline.summary: For $190 million up front and as much as $2.3 billion overall, the Swiss drugmaker is building its portfolio with a shot that aims to spur weight loss but spare muscle tissue.

pipeline.title: Regenxbio gene therapy refiling plan derailed by FDA hold over spine MRI findings
pipeline.summary: The FDA has put a clinical hold on Regenxbio’s RGX-121 over asymptomatic spine MRI findings, derailing the biotech’s plans to refile for approval of the once-rejected gene therapy candidate.

pipeline.title: Pharma marketers need a share-of-answer strategy before AI spend
pipeline.summary: AI is changing how HCPs seek answers. Pharma marketers need a new strategy.

pipeline.title: Roche pens $2.5B pact for Hanmi’s clinical-stage obesity drug targeting less-explored mechanism
pipeline.summary: Roche has taken its obesity strategy into uncharted territory via a $190 million upfront payment for a clinical-stage urocortin-2 analog from South Korea’s Hanmi Pharm.

pipeline.title: Daiichi Sankyo promotes Ken Keller to lead new commercialization unit
pipeline.summary: Daiichi Sankyo is promoting Ken Keller to lead a new globally integrated commercialization unit, putting the executive in charge of a key pillar of its push to become a top-five oncology company by 2035.

pipeline.title: Why a Texas congressman believes Chinese biotechs are 'beating us on our ground game'
pipeline.summary: The “knowledge base is going to start shifting quickly to China,” Rep. Nathaniel Moran, R-Texas, a member of the House Select Committee on China, told Fierce.

pipeline.title: Community Health Media drives 'credible medical expertise' through physician-led content
pipeline.summary: Education and insight company Community Health Media curates its content library by centering physicians as "the talent" and centering its content creation on insightful physician-led conversations.

pipeline.title: Lundbeck continues neuroscience evolution as CEO keeps company ‘punching above its weight’
pipeline.summary: Almost three years into his tenure as Lundbeck’s CEO, Charl van Zyl is confident the company can prove its mettle as a “neuroscience challenger” capable of “punching above its weight.”

pipeline.title: Regeneron podcast turns science learnings into immersive experience
pipeline.summary: Regeneron's "Science Illuminated" podcast series transforms scientific topics into a calming, meditative-style video and audio experience.

pipeline.title: Chutes & Ladders—Neumora shuffles leadership ahead of IND
pipeline.summary: Joshua Pinto, Ph.D., has been appointed chief executive officer of Neumora Therapeutics, a clinical-stage biotech with obesity and neuro assets.

pipeline.title: Roche earmarks $750M to double the size of its Oregon manufacturing facility
pipeline.summary: Roche will invest $750 million to double the size of its Genentech unit's manufacturing facility in Hillsboro, Oregon. The new outlay will support the construction of a fill-finish plant that will produce drug-delivery devices, such as prefilled syringes and auto-injectors. The f

pipeline.title: Xspray's Dasynoc approval bid foiled again by FDA's manufacturer concerns
pipeline.summary: Less than a year after the FDA turned down the resubmitted application for the company’s leukemia prospect Dasynoc, Xspray Pharma has again hit a wall at the U.S. regulator.

pipeline.title: Chai tees up Bristol Myers Squibb AI antibody discovery collab
pipeline.summary: A month after Chai Discovery tied up a major $400 million series C funding round, the AI drug discovery firm has teamed up with Bristol Myers Squibb.

pipeline.title: Lilly pens deal with Gateway Labs resident Amplitude for RNA vaccine platform for infectious disease
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly has turned to one of its Gateway Labs residents to help the Big Pharma develop trans-amplifying RNA (taRNA) vaccines for infectious diseases.

pipeline.title: Why Pheast’s CEO has no regrets about transparent approach to R&D despite competitors circling
pipeline.summary: Pheast Therapeutics may have learned the hard way about the risks of competitors getting a glimpse of your heard-earned discoveries, but the immuno-oncology startup is so far sticking to its transparent approach.

pipeline.title: Meet Aletta: The first FDA approved robotic blood draw device
pipeline.summary: The FDA has approved Vitestro’s Aletta as the first standalone robotic device in the U.S. designed to draw blood without the need for hands-on human help.

pipeline.title: Amgen abandoning $500M+ Crohn’s collab won’t derail TScan’s pipeline strategy
pipeline.summary: TScan has told Fierce that its pipeline strategy remains unchanged despite Amgen walking away from a Crohn’s disease collaboration that had the potential for a windfall of half a billion dollars.

pipeline.title: When is the new who: The importance of timing in HCP marketing
pipeline.summary: HCP marketers have spent years perfecting whom to reach. The harder question, and the one that decides whether a message lands, is when.

pipeline.title: Your Agency Knows the Brand. Are You Still Getting Its Best Thinking?
pipeline.summary: When clients start directing more and agencies start thinking less, it may feel like the relationship has run its course. But starting over isn’t the only way to get fresh thinking.

pipeline.title: A ‘renaissance for biomedicine’: human brain organoids model development for 5 years
pipeline.summary: Scientists’ ability to recapitulate the human brain in a dish has always been hindered by the inability to model the full capacity of the brain and its development through time.

pipeline.title: What did we learn from Big Pharma’s Q2 results?
pipeline.summary: Fierce editors break down Big Pharma’s second-quarter results, from AI and new leadership to the oral GLP-1 race and potential new blockbusters.

pipeline.title: ‘Money has spoken’: Why Chinese biotech CEOs tell Fierce they’re unfazed about rising US tensions
pipeline.summary: You might assume Chinese biotechs are enduring sleepless nights worrying about whether the ramping up of rhetoric in the U.S. is putting their new financial gains in peril. But the companies Fierce spoke to remained unconcerned.

pipeline.title: Regulatory tracker: GSK's world-first hep B nod; Another Trodelvy approval in EU
pipeline.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

pipeline.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Novo's Wegovy pill back on track as Lilly's momentum slows
pipeline.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.
